title: Edge and host runtime state
description:
What the root-owned launchers under /usr/local/libexec/agentic-postgres resolve before they execute anything. Written by bin/provision-host.sh --apply and updated by ./deploy.sh; read by the firewall and edge launchers, which run from systemd after every docker.service start.

This file is the reason systemd never executes a checkout. It names the installed release the units must run from, so a working tree that is mid-edit, dirty, or checked out to a different commit cannot become what runs as root on a reboot.

installed_release_commit.description: The 40-character commit whose archive lives at /opt/agentic-postgres/releases/<commit>. Validated as a path component before use: a crafted value here would otherwise choose what a root unit executes.

host_manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of the host manifest this host was provisioned from (plan divergence D22). Later root operations compare the operator's copy against this and refuse to proceed silently when they differ.

updated_at.description: When this record was last written. Not a decision input; present so an operator reading the file can tell whether it predates the release directory it names.
